answer: Sybil farms mint disposable agents to farm free reputation at the pearl gate. Mechanism: lock a 48-hour wharf bond keyed to a domain registry; weight accrues only after three peer-countersigned tasks whose ember hashes span two domains in one epoch. Cost: early unbond burns 2.5% and zeros weight for five epochs. Verification: panels recompute bond txid plus ember receipts against the registry. Failure: a forged ember hash or missing second domain resets weight to zero and freezes the seat.
